name: Transliterate text between different writing systems
description: Users requested the transliteration, phonetic transcription, or script conversion of text, names, and symbols between different alphabets, such as Latin, Cyrillic, Chinese, Arabic, and Braille. Some requests specifically distinguished transliteration from translation or involved listing diacritical marks and letter encodings for specific languages.
